unit.mapping: 1:1 at same logical width; crop px are at reference bitmap width 1206 (@3× of 402pt card width scale — use ratios vs src width)

card.notes: Three option cards share this aspect/height. Equal height SoT.

fillThenCrop.notes: Scale save image so width == card width (keep native aspect). Crop height to card. Do NOT scale-Y independently.

dataCard.description: Title card cut off above frame; map + 6 data cards visible; elevation card top slightly visible (~100px).

simpleGrey.description: Same fill-width then crop; slight top trim + bottom clip; no stretch.

simpleColor.description: Same fill-width then crop as Simple Grey; no stretch.

dimOverlay.notes: Uniform black dim over whole preview. Map/cards stay readable on liberty/SG/dark. Dim sits UNDER option title text and UNDER selected check badge.

optionTitle.notes: White text only — no dark capsule behind name.

selectedChip.notes: 「선택 완료」 Morph chip unchanged; drawn above dim.
